title: Overfull criteria for edge colouring (Plantholt; Chen–Cao; Cao–Chen–Jing–Shan), unified
abstract: A thin wrapper that restates, in one vocabulary and with Mathlib definitions only, the overfull criteria proved in PALOMAR-2026-11-04-000016 and PALOMAR-2026-11-04-000009. class_two_iff_overfull_subgraph: a finite simple graph of even order n with 12 n ≤ 7 (3δ − Δ) is of class two (its line graph is not Δ-colourable) iff it has a Δ-overfull subgraph (odd order at least 3, more than Δ (|V(H)| − 1)/2 edges); this is Plantholt's criterion with Chetwynd–Hilton's 6/7. critical_overfull: a Δ-critical graph (connected, class two, every edge-deleted subgraph Δ-colourable) with 2n + 5δ ≤ 3Δ + 6 (Chen–Cao), or 3n + 7δ ≤ 4Δ + 10 (Cao–Chen–Jing–Shan, variant), or 3n + 7δ ≤ 4Δ + 17 and n + δ ≥ 27 (Cao–Chen–Jing–Shan) has odd order, is overfull (|E| > Δ ⌊n/2⌋), and so is a Δ-overfull subgraph of itself. The only new proof is the elementary step from overfullness to odd order at least 3 (degree sum) and the conversion to the subgraph form. Two statements; no definitions beyond Mathlib's.
